deletePolicy.Description: Delete options of the AI Manager. Defaults to `Delete` if not specified.

managedResourceGroupName.Description: The name of the managed resource group created by the AI Manager to hold underlying infrastructure resources.

clusterResourceId.Description: The Azure resource ID of an existing AKS cluster to attach (bring-your-own). When omitted, AI Manager provisions and manages its own underlying cluster. The referenced cluster must be in the same region as this AI Manager, but may reside in a different subscription within the same Microsoft Entra tenant. This property is immutable after creation.

principalId.Description: The service principal ID of the system assigned identity. This property will only be provided for a system assigned identity.

tenantId.Description: The tenant ID of the system assigned identity. This property will only be provided for a system assigned identity.

type.Description: Type of managed service identity (where both SystemAssigned and UserAssigned types are allowed).

userAssignedIdentities.Description: The set of user assigned identities associated with the resource. The userAssignedIdentities dictionary keys will be ARM resource ids in the form: '/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/{identityName}. The dictionary values can be empty objects ({}) in requests.

principalId.Description: The principal ID of the assigned identity.

clientId.Description: The client ID of the assigned identity.

createdBy.Description: The identity that created the resource.

createdByType.Description: The type of identity that created the resource.

lastModifiedBy.Description: The identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedByType.Description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedAt.Description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)

systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

provisioningState.Description: The status of the last operation.

modelId.Description:
The model identifier, interpreted per the referenced ModelSource type.
For `HuggingFace` sources this is the upstream `<org>/<repo>` id, e.g.
`meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat`. For `MicrosoftFoundry` sources this is
`modelName/version`, e.g. `private-llama/1`. Immutable after creation.

baseModel.Description: The base model this custom model was trained from (id + config.json). Immutable after creation.

modelSourceResourceId.Description: Azure resource id of the ModelSource to use when pulling artifacts. Used to determine model location and access. Immutable after creation.

description.Description: Optional. Free-form description of the model. Mutable.

spec.Description: Read-only. Platform-resolved specification of the model.

id.Description: The HuggingFace `<org>/<repo>` id of the base model, e.g. `meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat`. Immutable after creation.

totalWeightSizeBytes.Description: The total size of the model weights in bytes. eg `28000000000`. Required if the base model is not publicly accessible on HuggingFace.

config.Description: The verbatim `config.json` of the base model, supplied by the user. Required if the base model is not publicly accessible on HuggingFace.  For more information on CustomAIModel configuration see https://aka.ms/aks/aim-customaimodel.

license.Description: The license of the model, when known. SPDX license identifier, e.g. `mit`, `apache-2.0`.

isRestricted.Description: Whether access to the model is restricted and requires credential.

maxContextLength.Description: The maximum context length supported by the model, in tokens.

provisioningState.Description: The status of the last operation.

sourceType.Description: Model source type. Constrains the legal authentication kinds. Immutable after creation.

description.Description: An optional, free-form description of the source.

credential.Description: Credential the platform uses to authenticate to the source. Optional for public sources (e.g. ungated Hugging Face models).

microsoftFoundry.Description: Microsoft Foundry project reference. Required when `sourceType` is `MicrosoftFoundry`; must be omitted otherwise. Immutable after creation.

inline.Description: An inline credential containing a secret value supplied in the request payload.

managedIdentity.Description:
A user-assigned managed identity the platform authenticates as. Required for `MicrosoftFoundry` sources and
  the user must grant the `Foundry User` role (role definition id 53ca6127-db72-4b80-b1b0-d745d6d5456d) on the Foundry project.
  See https://aka.ms/aks/aim-modelsource for more details.
  The platform federates this identity to an in-cluster puller ServiceAccount (Workload Identity) at deployment time.

value.Description: The access token, password, or other secret value.

resourceId.Description: The Azure resource id of the user-assigned managed identity to authenticate with. Only user-assigned identities are supported.

projectResourceId.Description: The ARM resource id of the Foundry project. The scope on which the referenced managed identity must hold the `Foundry User` role. The account and endpoint host are derived from this id.

eTag.Description: If eTag is provided in the response body, it may also be provided as a header per the normal etag convention. systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

provisioningState.Description: The status of the last reconciliation.

modelResourceId.Description: Full Azure resource ID of the model to deploy. Immutable after creation.

modelSourceResourceId.Description: Full Azure resource ID of a `ModelSource` to use when pulling artifacts for this deployment. Immutable after creation.

vmSize.Description: Azure VM SKU used to host the deployment, e.g. "Standard_NC96ads_A100_v4". Immutable after creation.

scale.Description: Scaling configuration for the deployment. Provide either `manual` (fixed replica count) or `autoscale` (autoscaling between min/max replicas), but not both.

overrides.Description: User overrides layered on top of profile resolution.

status.Description: Runtime status, populated once reconciliation begins.

manual.Description: Manual scaling configuration with a fixed replica count. Mutually exclusive with `autoscale`.

replicas.Description: Fixed number of replicas. May be `0` to stop serving traffic while keeping the deployment configuration (see `ScalingProfile`).

minReplicas.Description: The minimum number of replicas. Must be at least `1`; scale-to-zero is not supported in autoscale mode (see `ScalingProfile`).

maxReplicas.Description: The maximum number of replicas. If not specified, the service derives a default from the subscription GPU quota.

values.Description: Experimental free-form override key/value pairs. Subject to change without notice; not part of the stable contract. Recognized keys are documented per release and may be added, renamed, or removed at any time.

endpoint.Description: The inference endpoint URL exposed by the deployment, once ready.

engine.Description: The inference engine used to serve the model, e.g. "vllm".

engineVersion.Description: The version of the inference engine, e.g. "0.17".

maxModelLen.Description: The maximum model context length, in tokens, configured for this deployment.

quantization.Description: The quantization level applied to the model weights, e.g. "fp16", "awq-int4".

desiredReplicas.Description: The desired replica count reported by the controller. Equals `properties.scale.manual.replicas` when manual scaling is used; current target replica count derived from autoscaler otherwise.

currentReplicas.Description: The current number of ready replicas serving traffic.

peakTokensPerMinute.Description: The peak tokens per minute measured by live stress test.

estimatedProvisionTimeSeconds.Description: Estimated total time, in seconds, for the deployment to become ready end-to-end (GPU vm provisioning, image/weight pull, engine warm-up).

properties.Description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

modelId.Description: The Hugging Face model identifier in `<org>/<repo>` form, e.g. `microsoft/Phi-4-mini-instruct`. Uniquely identifies the upstream model that backs this catalog entry.

description.Description: An optional, free-form description of the model.

license.Description: The license of the model, when known. SPDX license identifier, e.g. `mit`, `apache-2.0`.

isRestricted.Description: Whether access to the model is restricted and requires credential.

maxContextLength.Description: The maximum context length supported by the model, in tokens.

endpoint.Description: OpenAI-compatible inference gateway base URL (for example, `https://team-alpha.<cluster>.<region>.aksapp.io/v1`).

primaryKey.Description: Primary API key. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `api-key: <key>`. Treat as secret; do not log or persist in plaintext.

secondaryKey.Description: Secondary API key, accepted by the gateway in the same headers as `primaryKey`. Generated independently when the namespace is created, then overwritten by the previous `primaryKey` on each `rotateKeys` call so clients can roll over without downtime. Treat as secret; do not log or persist in plaintext.

lastRotatedAt.Description: UTC time the keys were last rotated by `rotateKeys`. Absent until the first rotation. Clients can use this to detect rotation and refresh cached credentials.
